blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Bureau of Customs at the Ninoy Aquino International Airport (BOC-Naia) seized 307.866 kilograms of high-grade marijuana, or kush, worth an estimated ₱369.44 million in two shipments from Thailand on Monday, Nov. 23.
